reason: The README describes a terminal frontend and HTTP/SSE bridge that exposes DeepSeek Harness agents, sessions, models, permissions, questions, and file-oriented tools through the official OpenCode TUI, making agent orchestration the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过官方 OpenCode 终端界面接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供智能体、会话、模型、权限和工具交互能力。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official OpenCode terminal UI for interacting with agents, sessions, models, permissions, and tools.

capabilities: Starts and attaches to the official OpenCode terminal UI
Manages agents, sessions, models, permissions, questions, goals, and sub-agent sessions
Streams messages and tool parameters through SSE
Supports bash, read, write, edit, diff, and modified-file tool interactions
Allows session cancellation and in-memory session permission approvals
